kp-update 2026-10-02: py3d 1.9.0 _check_component_coverage (WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE). Up to 1.8.0, and on main after #46, it read the Geometry LOD only when it held a selection named exactly 'Component01' and compared that selection alone with the whole LOD ('Component01 covers %d/%d vertices; uncovered vertices won't participate in collision.' and the same for faces): it fired whenever Component01 held fewer points or faces than the LOD, as on a healthy multi-component LOD, never read a LOD without an exact Component01 (lowercase components included), counted proxy triangles and points that no face uses, and did not run on View or Fire. Owner's choices the same day: coverage is the union of every selection named Component plus a number, in any case (#46's _COMPONENT_NAME_RE, fullmatch), on the Geometry, View and Fire LODs; points that no face uses are ignored; it stays a WARN. Implementation: it counts the faces that are not proxy triangles (#46's _proxy_triangle_faces) that no component holds, and the points those faces use that none holds; a nonzero weight is membership, as in the file; one finding per LOD; a LOD with no component is left to ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING, and one whose component selections are all empty is reported with every face counted; it ships under #46's unreleased 1.9.0 with no new wheel. In-game basis: the killer #2 run (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs collided with nothing; a face outside every component on a LOD that has others was not measured, so killer #8 now calls that consequence expected, not measured, and quotes the replaced text in dated notes. Offline: py3d suite 334 passed, 11 skipped (base: 309 passed, 11 skipped); the 25 new tests of test_s2_validate12.py run against the base commit's module fail 20 and pass 5 (guards: lowercase components covering the LOD, a LOD with no component, the face-outside mutant whose message test discriminates, and fractional weights, which instead fail on a mutant that counts only weight 1), and all 25 pass on the new one; dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH. Read-only impact run on 414 unique MLODs (the owner's mod and vehicle projects and the Pack's door samples) through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the base module and the new one: old 78 findings on 39 Geometry LODs, new 3 (the door sample Expert_Mode, whose lever is in no component in its Geometry and Fire LODs, and a vehicle Fire LOD with two 1 mm triangles in no selection); no other finding changed in any model. The impact and consumer runs used the module of 7cb410f; the review fixes after it change no executable line (AST compared without docstrings). Cross-family review: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of 2 rounds set before round 1: round 1 SOUND-WITH-FIXES (three P2, fixed), round 2 SOUND (all three resolved, no new finding). Skill notes on this finding (dayz-p3d-audit SKILL.md killer #8, references/killers-detail.md section 8) now say which py3d version does what; the py3d README test count follows the suite. Written by Claude (Anthropic).

In-game A/B (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, 2026-10-02, dayz-mcp run 454c93d7; dayz-p3d-audit killer #2, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): component01 collided exactly like Component01 (scene_raycast geom/view/fire 6 of 6 per mode, RayCastBullet, a walking player stopped 0.36 m before the face), unbinarized and binarized, and binarize writes both as component01; a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs took 0 rays, missed the physics ray, let the player through, and no log line said so. Owner's choices the same day: the case is not checked (WARN_COMPONENT_NAMING only when no component-like name is Component plus a number, e.g. only Component_01, never measured); the missing-component ERROR runs on Geometry, View and Fire, each LOD on its own (a single LOD missing it was not measured); faces in proxy selections do not count, so a faceless or proxy-only LOD raises nothing; version 1.9.0 in source, no new wheel (the pinned and installed py3d_dayz-1.8.0 keeps the old check; apply-s2-rollout.ps1 -WheelOnly refuses a restock until a 1.9.0 wheel is pinned); WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE left for a separate task. Round 2 (gpt-6.1-sol on 565f4cb): SOUND-WITH-FIXES, F1, F2, F4, F5 and F6 fixed, F3 partial (R2-1, P2: a proxy-named selection of 3 points that are not its triangle's corners kept the exemption); fixed after the two-round cap and checked mechanically: the 3 selected points must be the triangle's 3 distinct corners, and on the corpus that rule accepts the same 877 proxy triangles as the shape rule (431 Fire, 433 View, 13 Geometry) and changes no finding. kp-update 2026-10-02 promotion unblock. Schema 1 binds a promotion receipt to the checkout that applied it; the nine receipts in promotions/receipts were sealed from a temporary worktree that no longer exists, so promote --check failed with PROMOTION-RECEIPT-JOURNAL-MISMATCH on all nine and the pre-apply journal sweep with PROMOTION-RECOVERY-REQUIRED (diagnosis by Codex on 2026-10-01; re-read in packctl/promotion.py). packctl now reads such a receipt from any checkout whose HEAD tracks it at promotions/receipts/<transaction_id>.json with the same bytes, still matched against the sealed plan and the COMMIT receipt hash; the sweep uses the same rule when the sealed path is gone. A relocated receipt explains targets in a check only when every target its sealed plan wrote lies under the root this installation configures for the same logical target, so a repository sharing the backup root cannot borrow it; the sealed path must be gone, no link may sit on the way, and the file must equal the raw blob at HEAD. Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, round 1 on cf209a5: UNSOUND (P1: receipts copied into another repository's HEAD explained its targets; P2: check and sweep picked different copies; P2: filtered hashes; P3: tests that let mutants survive), all acted upon. Round 2 on 350f6c0: UNSOUND (P1: a configured root moved to its parent still contained the sealed paths, so a receipt explained a concrete path it never wrote; P2: an unreadable sealed path counted as gone; P3: no filter regression), fixed after the last round: a relocated receipt explains a (artifact, target) pair only when the concrete path it wrote is the one this check writes, the sealed path must be absent by os.lstat, and a real clean/smudge filter test pins the raw-byte comparison. Fourteen cases in tests/packctl/test_promotion.py; nine mutants, one per rule, each fail their case. Written by Claude (Anthropic).

kp-update 2026-10-01 rig handedness audit, the follow-up of the Rule 12 in-game test: every det=+1 Blender->DayZ map still taught in the character, clothing and animation skills was checked against measured frames. Official rig FBX re-measured in Blender 5.1.1 with both FBX importers: front -Y, left +X, armature matrix_world = R(+90 X), FBX-local frame right-handed (front +Z, left +X). DayZ bind: front -Z, left +X (vanilla left* on +X; worn frame verified in game). Hence Blender->DayZ = (x,z,y), det=-1, as Rule 12; this explains LFInfectedBig S7 (backward with (x,z,-y)) and S9 (mirror with (-x,z,y)). check_dayz_winding.py measured failing all three MLODs of the Rule 12 in-game probe, the correct one included. ArmorHneck's received p3d is the (x,z,-y) export of the artist's Blender file (project notes). The viewer frame of the animation pipeline is right-handed (det=+1 from Blender), relabelled; the calibrated Route C conversion is det=-1. Chiral in-game checks designed, not run. Merged with main after py3d 1.8.0 (#29) and its proxy docs (#30): the character Stage B keeps this derivation and takes py3d.blender_to_dayz() as the one-call form of the swap and ROT_X_NEG90 as the renamed det=+1 matrix; the clothing return trip is blender_to_dayz() for new packages and ROT_X_NEG90 for packages made before 2026-10-01. Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, two rounds (cap set by the author): round 1 UNSOUND (fix of a received worn p3d by its state, old winding gate scoped by the stored-normal sign, model-pipeline OBJ export recipes, viewer space label, moved citations), all acted upon; round 2 closed those and found three coverage P1 (two OBJ export remnants, a troubleshooting row that reversed faces on Check A), fixed after the last round with mechanical checks. Written by Claude (Anthropic).

kp-update 2026-10-02: py3d 1.9.0 _check_component_naming. Up to 1.8.0 it ran on the Geometry LOD alone and raised ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING on a lowercase component01 ('Engine requires Component01 (uppercase C); collision silently fails'). In-game A/B (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, 2026-10-02, dayz-mcp run 454c93d7; dayz-p3d-audit killer #2, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): component01 collided exactly like Component01 (scene_raycast geom/view/fire 6 of 6 per mode, RayCastBullet, a walking player stopped 0.36 m before the face), unbinarized and binarized, and binarize writes both as component01; a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs took 0 rays, missed the physics ray, let the player through, and no log line said so. Owner's choices the same day: the case is not checked (WARN_COMPONENT_NAMING only when no component-like name is Component plus a number, e.g. only Component_01, never measured); the missing-component ERROR runs on Geometry, View and Fire, each LOD on its own (a single LOD missing it was not measured); faces in proxy selections do not count, so a faceless or proxy-only LOD raises nothing; version 1.9.0 in source, no new wheel (the pinned and installed py3d_dayz-1.8.0 keeps the old check; apply-s2-rollout.ps1 -WheelOnly refuses a restock until a 1.9.0 wheel is pinned); WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE left for a separate task. Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, round 1 SOUND-WITH-FIXES (six P2, no P1), fixed: the component name is matched with fullmatch, so 'Component01' plus a trailing newline gets the spelling WARN; only a proxy-shaped selection (a 'proxy:<path>.<index>' name holding exactly 1 triangle and, as its 3 points, that triangle's corners) exempts its face, so a cube under a proxy name is collision geometry (on the corpus below the library's strict proxy anatomy rejects 229 real proxy triangles, the shape rule rejects only 18 proxy-named 8-point selections in LFPowerGrid logic gates, whose LODs all carry components); the message and the README say that the measured case is no component in any collision LOD and that one LOD missing it alone was not measured; the skill text states ERROR for no component-like name and WARN for irregular names only; the knowledge note on Object Builder's case-sensitivity is qualified as unmeasured. Round 2 (gpt-6.1-sol on 565f4cb): SOUND-WITH-FIXES, F1, F2, F4, F5 and F6 fixed, F3 partial (R2-1, P2: a proxy-named selection of 3 points that are not its triangle's corners kept the exemption); fixed after the two-round cap and checked mechanically: the 3 selected points must be the triangle's 3 distinct corners, and on the corpus that rule accepts the same 877 proxy triangles as the shape rule (431 Fire, 433 View, 13 Geometry) and changes no finding. Offline: py3d suite 304 passed, 11 skipped before merging main's #40 (baseline 283 passed, 11 skipped) and 309 passed, 11 skipped after it (#40 adds 5); test_s2_validate12.py (61 tests) fails 19 against the base commit's __init__.py, 8 against the round-1 head and 3 (the corner cases) against the round-2 head, and passes 61 of 61 on the new one; five mutants (no exemption for Fire, WARN when any name is irregular, match() with '$', proxy exemption by name only, proxy corners not checked) are each killed by the test meant for it; dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH. Read-only impact run (verify_impact.py) on 414 unique MLODs of the owner's mod and vehicle projects and the Pack's door samples, through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the base module and the new one: old 94 ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING, all on Geometry LODs (88 with lowercase component names, 5 on Geometry LODs without faces, among them debinarized vanilla sedanwheel_destroyed, 1 with faces and no component); new 1 (that last one); 93 models change verdict, all from that error to none; no finding appears only after the change (every View and Fire LOD with faces carries a component). tools/py3d/KNOWN-ISSUES.md is registered by output_hash only, as #29 and #30 did: its entry carries two adopt inputs and a new merge input would trip SOURCE-CONFLICT-UNDECIDED. Owner's choices the same day: coverage is the union of every selection named Component plus a number, in any case (#46's _COMPONENT_NAME_RE, fullmatch), on the Geometry, View and Fire LODs; points that no face uses are ignored; it stays a WARN. Implementation: it counts the faces that are not proxy triangles (#46's _proxy_triangle_faces) that no component holds, and the points those faces use that none holds; a nonzero weight is membership, as in the file; one finding per LOD; a LOD with no component is left to ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING, and one whose component selections are all empty is reported with every face counted; it ships under #46's unreleased 1.9.0 with no new wheel. In-game basis: the killer #2 run (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs collided with nothing; a face outside every component on a LOD that has others was not measured, so killer #8 now calls that consequence expected, not measured, and quotes the replaced text in dated notes. Offline: py3d suite 334 passed, 11 skipped (base: 309 passed, 11 skipped); the 25 new tests of test_s2_validate12.py run against the base commit's module fail 20 and pass 5 (guards: lowercase components covering the LOD, a LOD with no component, the face-outside mutant whose message test discriminates, and fractional weights, which instead fail on a mutant that counts only weight 1), and all 25 pass on the new one; dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH. Read-only impact run on 414 unique MLODs (the owner's mod and vehicle projects and the Pack's door samples) through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the base module and the new one: old 78 findings on 39 Geometry LODs, new 3 (the door sample Expert_Mode, whose lever is in no component in its Geometry and Fire LODs, and a vehicle Fire LOD with two 1 mm triangles in no selection); no other finding changed in any model. The impact and consumer runs used the module of 7cb410f; the review fixes after it change no executable line (AST compared without docstrings). Cross-family review: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of 2 rounds set before round 1: round 1 SOUND-WITH-FIXES (three P2, fixed), round 2 SOUND (all three resolved, no new finding). Extended 2026-08-21: stringtable_validator.py is labelled broken for DayZ where the skill lists it, and the stringtable section carries the measured caveat that an addon carrying only a stringtable is not a valid minimal test case - its PBO mounted and served a .layout loaded by addon prefix while a key defined by that same PBO printed as its own name, and adding prefix, dependencies[] or the full CfgMods shape of a shipping mod changed nothing, with a vanilla key resolving in the same frame as the positive control and every PBO re-extracted to confirm the csv was inside it.

Cited LL-367 (commit 1082b5a) so packctl can promote that orphan lesson into the live skill: a release artifact traces to the commit by hash of its entire source tree, not of the touched files; an incremental sync only verifies its own delta.

A mod can carry two divergent PBOs and the gate can be pointed at the wrong one. Measured on LFQuad: the source-tree package was 5.92 MB with a binarised model, the deployed one under Mods\@<Mod>\Addons was 17.22 MB with the raw MLOD and dated a day earlier, and both held 73 entries, 5 .c, 36 .paa and 23 .rvmat, so neither looked broken. The one the game loads was the older. Extended 2026-08-20 with section 6 / the measurements from six flights against DayZ 1.29.163709 at 1280x720 and 1920x1080: #STR_ keys DO resolve in a $profile: preview (one frame carrying a vanilla key, another mod's key and an undefined one), GetText() returns the raw key even when the screen shows the resolved string, glyph height tracks the widget height (same file, root 1 1 vs 0.30 0.05), six text_proportion values left it at 104 px, and a preview draws above the inventory yet never receives a click. Every claim has a capture behind it. SUPERSEDED 2026-08-21 by three further flights: what was written as an open question is answered. text_proportion is honoured on TextWidgetClass and on ButtonWidgetClass and follows glyph = 0.74 x value x box height (fit on TextWidget: predicted 80/16.0/16.0/48.0 against measured 80/16/16/47; out of sample on ButtonWidget: predicted 12.8/38.4 against measured 13/38), and it is IGNORED on MultilineTextWidgetClass, where a cell declaring 0.20 measured the same 80 px as a cell declaring nothing at all. The 2026-08-20 sweep ran on a MultilineTextWidgetClass, so its null was real and the conclusion drawn from it was not. Two candidates were refuted by the frame: '"exact text" 0' is not a prerequisite despite sitting in the same widget block as text_proportion 82.6% of the time against a 3.1% base rate across 821 layouts, and the attribute's position inside the block does not matter. Each cell differed from an in-frame control in exactly one thing, the window chrome was removed before measuring, and the gaps between boxes were checked empty. kp-update 2026-10-02 promotion unblock. Schema 1 binds a promotion receipt to the checkout that applied it; the nine receipts in promotions/receipts were sealed from a temporary worktree that no longer exists, so promote --check failed with PROMOTION-RECEIPT-JOURNAL-MISMATCH on all nine and the pre-apply journal sweep with PROMOTION-RECOVERY-REQUIRED (diagnosis by Codex on 2026-10-01; re-read in packctl/promotion.py). packctl now reads such a receipt from any checkout whose HEAD tracks it at promotions/receipts/<transaction_id>.json with the same bytes, still matched against the sealed plan and the COMMIT receipt hash; the sweep uses the same rule when the sealed path is gone. A relocated receipt explains targets in a check only when every target its sealed plan wrote lies under the root this installation configures for the same logical target, so a repository sharing the backup root cannot borrow it; the sealed path must be gone, no link may sit on the way, and the file must equal the raw blob at HEAD. Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, round 1 on cf209a5: UNSOUND (P1: receipts copied into another repository's HEAD explained its targets; P2: check and sweep picked different copies; P2: filtered hashes; P3: tests that let mutants survive), all acted upon. Round 2 on 350f6c0: UNSOUND (P1: a configured root moved to its parent still contained the sealed paths, so a receipt explained a concrete path it never wrote; P2: an unreadable sealed path counted as gone; P3: no filter regression), fixed after the last round: a relocated receipt explains a (artifact, target) pair only when the concrete path it wrote is the one this check writes, the sealed path must be absent by os.lstat, and a real clean/smudge filter test pins the raw-byte comparison. Fourteen cases in tests/packctl/test_promotion.py; nine mutants, one per rule, each fail their case. Written by Claude (Anthropic).

Winding section: 'The correct fix for an inverted face is always face.vertices.reverse()' replaced by the disagreement reading and a three-step order (winding of visual LODs, winding of collision LODs, normals corner by corner), as dayz-p3d-audit 'Absolute winding check: what 0 % means' (rules 1, 4, 5) and references/winding-diagnostics.md (Check A; from Check B to fix: groups by shared edge, pool mechanics) establish, with dayz-model-pipeline Rule 12 (in game 2026-10-01, DayZDiag 1.29.163709: cross product and stored normals both inward), Rule 18 (per-component outward check) and Rule 1 (Geometry components convex); LFSecure 2026-09-07, DayZDiag 1.29: reversing every face on a 0 % reading rendered two exports inside-out, negating their normals rendered them right side out; adds that the absolute check cannot see faces and normals turned together (transform(ROT_X_NEG90) alone, variant C, 100 % agreement, validate() returns []), that open sheets and double-sided parts are left out, that copies count toward the 32768-entry budget validate() checks, and that a wrong normal sign renders solid but lit inverted (CLAIM-CHAR-NORMALS-INWARD-INGAME) instead of inside-out; test counts 290/283 (measured with and without PY3D_UPSTREAM_PATH). The fix order the message and README give: settle the winding first with normals untouched (visual LOD: per closed shell, turn the vertex order of the faces that disagree with their neighbours, then reverse the whole shell if its signed volume by winding has the wrong sign; collision LOD: reverse the faces that point outward in each convex component), then negate each corner normal still against its face, re-pointing corners whose entry a kept corner also uses to an existing entry with the negated value or a negated copy. Offline, on the Rule 12 in-game fixture (variant B rebuilt byte for byte, SHA-256 asserted against MEASURED): B with its normals negated and B with its faces reversed both read 0 % and raise the same finding with identical text; per-box signed volume keeps B's negative sign (-0.084, -0.0132, -0.0066, -0.0048) with the normals turned and flips it with the faces turned; the wrong fix silences the finding and leaves cross product and normals outward on 48/48 faces; validate() returns [] on variant C. Cases from the two review rounds, each re-run by the receptor and now a test: a 6-entry shared pool negated in place leaves 75 % with the stem's 12 faces wrong; a plate with one reversed face keeps volume -0.084, so the volume alone leaves that face inside-out; turning a right odd face with its normal leaves 47/48 with validate() == []; negating whole faces on a first-corner reading leaves 48 of 144 corners right with 100 % agreement; the order above gives back B (48/48/48, 144 corners, pool kept at 6) in every case. A synthetic ring-shaped FireGeometry reads 264 of 336 correct faces outward by the centroid test. py3d suite 283 passed, 11 skipped (290 passed, 4 skipped with PY3D_UPSTREAM_PATH at upstream 7acd58b). Negative controls on the 8 new tests: da73457 fails 3, round-1 6a13435 fails 2, round-2 42a9d5b fails 1, and a mutated solid, room or collision sign fails 1 each. The visual shell's signed volume by winding reads negative on the clean model and positive turned (also what a room seen from inside is); the collision boxes read 0 of 6 faces outward clean and 6 of 6 turned. kp-update 2026-10-02: py3d 1.9.0 _check_component_coverage (WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE). Up to 1.8.0, and on main after #46, it read the Geometry LOD only when it held a selection named exactly 'Component01' and compared that selection alone with the whole LOD ('Component01 covers %d/%d vertices; uncovered vertices won't participate in collision.' and the same for faces): it fired whenever Component01 held fewer points or faces than the LOD, as on a healthy multi-component LOD, never read a LOD without an exact Component01 (lowercase components included), counted proxy triangles and points that no face uses, and did not run on View or Fire. BLENDER_TO_DAYZ is deprecated through a module __getattr__ (FutureWarning, value unchanged, also published as ROT_X_NEG90); proxy triangles move like any face; a second in-game probe the same day (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, run 7e4d808b, ODOL read with the LL-505 reader) measured collision LODs (raycasts hit in geom/view/fire, none after the det=+1 map alone) and static proxies drawn in Blender as canonical raw triangles (same ODOL frames as add_proxy(space=engine), rendered in the pose drawn), so the proxy warning was replaced by that documented result; a Point object or facenormals list listed twice (shared between LODs) is refused before any change, after a cross-family review (Codex gpt-6-sol) showed transform() would map it twice. A second cross-family round (Codex gpt-6-sol, on 2d7cf28) led the docstring to state that normals come out unit-length, so two calls give back unit normals, and that near-zero ones stay unmapped. The same file goes to the published fork in willy92wins/py3d-dayz#1. Authored by Claude (Anthropic) on the owner's request; PR reviewed by the owner before merge.

_check_winding_absolute: the ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS message no longer reads a disagreement between winding and stored normals as faces wound backwards with face.vertices.reverse() as the fix. It says the two disagree, not which is wrong, that the check reads each face's first corner, and gives the fix order below, as dayz-p3d-audit 'Absolute winding check: what 0 % means' (rules 1, 4, 5) and references/winding-diagnostics.md (Check A; from Check B to fix: groups by shared edge, pool mechanics) establish, with dayz-model-pipeline Rule 12 (in game 2026-10-01, DayZDiag 1.29.163709: cross product and stored normals both inward), Rule 18 (per-component outward check) and Rule 1 (Geometry components convex); LFSecure 2026-09-07, DayZDiag 1.29: reversing every face on a 0 % reading rendered two exports inside-out, negating their normals rendered them right side out. The docstring names the det=-1 map that keeps the face order. Finding code and severity unchanged. The fix order the message and README give: settle the winding first with normals untouched (visual LOD: per closed shell, turn the vertex order of the faces that disagree with their neighbours, then reverse the whole shell if its signed volume by winding has the wrong sign; collision LOD: reverse the faces that point outward in each convex component), then negate each corner normal still against its face, re-pointing corners whose entry a kept corner also uses to an existing entry with the negated value or a negated copy. Offline, on the Rule 12 in-game fixture (variant B rebuilt byte for byte, SHA-256 asserted against MEASURED): B with its normals negated and B with its faces reversed both read 0 % and raise the same finding with identical text; per-box signed volume keeps B's negative sign (-0.084, -0.0132, -0.0066, -0.0048) with the normals turned and flips it with the faces turned; the wrong fix silences the finding and leaves cross product and normals outward on 48/48 faces; validate() returns [] on variant C. Cases from the two review rounds, each re-run by the receptor and now a test: a 6-entry shared pool negated in place leaves 75 % with the stem's 12 faces wrong; a plate with one reversed face keeps volume -0.084, so the volume alone leaves that face inside-out; turning a right odd face with its normal leaves 47/48 with validate() == []; negating whole faces on a first-corner reading leaves 48 of 144 corners right with 100 % agreement; the order above gives back B (48/48/48, 144 corners, pool kept at 6) in every case. A synthetic ring-shaped FireGeometry reads 264 of 336 correct faces outward by the centroid test. py3d suite 283 passed, 11 skipped (290 passed, 4 skipped with PY3D_UPSTREAM_PATH at upstream 7acd58b). Negative controls on the 8 new tests: da73457 fails 3, round-1 6a13435 fails 2, round-2 42a9d5b fails 1, and a mutated solid, room or collision sign fails 1 each. Authored by Claude (Anthropic) on the owner's request (2026-10-02: make the py3d ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS hint say what is established). Cross-family review on PR #37 by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of two rounds set before round 1: round 1 UNSOUND (shared pool entries; a shell with one reversed face; concave components; an unqualified docstring; tests blind to an inverted sign), round 2 UNSOUND (turning a right odd face with its normal; whole-face negation on a first-corner reading; the 32768 normal budget; the room sign untested), every finding reproduced by the receptor; the round-2 findings fixed after the cap and verified mechanically.

_check_winding_vs_visual: the ERR_WINDING_INVERTED message no longer tells the reader to reverse every face of the collision LOD. It names the visual LOD it compares against (lowest resolution, by index and resolution; _scan_v12_findings passes the index); says the collision LOD and that visual LOD disagree on which way is out, by a centroid test that assumes convex geometry, not which one is wrong; gives for both LODs the order of ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS (the winding first, normals untouched: visual LOD per closed shell by its signed volume, collision LOD per convex component; never a vertices[1]/[2] swap; then each corner normal still against its face), steps that leave a part that reads right as it is; calls a part those steps cannot read unresolved; and says there is nothing to fix only when every part of both LODs reads right (a visual LOD meant to be seen from inside reads positive). Both messages take the winding steps from one helper, _winding_steps, as dayz-model-pipeline Rule 12 (in game 2026-10-01, DayZDiag 1.29.163709: cross product and stored normals both inward) and Rule 18 (per-component outward check on collision LODs), the py3d README 'Winding' steps 1-3 (#37), dayz-p3d-audit killer #1 (#38: the finding is a trigger, Rule 18 decides, an unresolved check confirms nothing) and 'Absolute winding check: what 0 % means' (rules 4 and 7; rule 6, #39: on lf_kit_box.p3d the finding named collision LODs wound outward, which registered no raycast in game, and it also fires on healthy collision LODs under an inverted Visual LOD), and dayz-vehicles references/visual-gates-and-winding.md ('if Visual is the inverted one, it blames HEALTHY collision LODs') establish. The docstring says the same. Finding code, severity and thresholds unchanged. Offline, 2026-10-02, on the clean multi-LOD model of the py3d tests (build_multilod_v2_p3d after blender_to_dayz(), validate() == []): with the visual LOD's shell turned inside-out, faces and normals together (the absolute check passes it), ERR_WINDING_INVERTED fired on the three healthy collision LODs (geometry, view_geometry, fire_geometry: 0 % of faces wound outward from the LOD centroid, visual 100 %) and nowhere else, and no other finding saw the inside-out visual LOD; with the geometry LOD turned instead, on that LOD only (100 % vs 0 %). The visual shell's signed volume by winding reads negative on the clean model and positive turned (also what a room seen from inside is); the collision boxes read 0 of 6 faces outward clean and 6 of 6 turned. The message's winding steps, run on the visual LOD it names and on the collision LODs, reversed the turned LOD and nothing else (320 shell faces, or 6), and fixing the corners then gave back the clean model exactly (points, normal pools, vertex and normal indices, UVs). With two visual LODs, healthy LOD 0 at resolution 10 and inside-out LOD 1 at resolution 0, every finding names LOD 1 while get_lod('visual') returns LOD 0; the steps on LOD 0 change nothing and on LOD 1 clear the findings. An inside-out open surface (the shell less one face: 319 faces, all wound outward) raises the finding on the three collision LODs and the steps change nothing, so the message calls such a part unresolved. Reversing the faces of the three flagged LODs, the old message's fix, traded the finding for ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS on each; negating their normals as well left validate() at [] with every LOD wound outward, the collision boxes 6 of 6 outward as transform(ROT_X_NEG90) alone leaves them, the map whose collision LODs registered no raycast in game (py3d README, Blender -> DayZ). On 12 turned states (the visual LOD or one collision LOD, its faces, its normals or both) the 8 ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS messages are byte-identical to main's and every finding's code, severity and LOD index is unchanged. py3d suite 288 passed, 11 skipped (295 passed, 4 skipped with PY3D_UPSTREAM_PATH at upstream 7acd58b; main: 283 and 290). Of the five new tests, the four on the message fail on main's __init__.py (sha256 66d8748d...) and the old-fix test passes on both; swapping the solid/room signs in the relative message only, naming the first visual LOD instead of the reference, or dropping the unresolved clause each fails at least one of them. Nothing new was loaded in game. Authored by Claude (Anthropic) on the owner's request (2026-10-02: make the py3d ERR_WINDING_INVERTED hint say what the relative check establishes). Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol (cap of two rounds, set before round 1): round 1 UNSOUND with two findings, both reproduced by the receptor and fixed - R21-01 (P1) the message did not name the reference visual LOD, so with two visual LODs the steps went to the healthy one get_lod('visual') returns; R21-02 (P2) 'nothing to fix' had no unresolved outcome for a part the steps cannot read - and its negative question (a sign swap confined to the relative message passed every new test) closed by tying each sign phrase to its measurement; snapshot() now compares UVs. Round 2 (fresh session, on 00d73e4): SOUND - R21-01, R21-02 and the negative question closed, no finding. Its negative question (a steps index that differs from the named one passed the five tests; the code was right) was closed after the cap: named_visual() now requires the two indices to agree, verified mechanically by the receptor (that mutant fails three tests, the branch passes all five, py3d suite unchanged at 288 and 295); not re-reviewed.

kp-update 2026-10-02: py3d 1.9.0 _check_component_coverage (WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE). Up to 1.8.0, and on main after #46, it read the Geometry LOD only when it held a selection named exactly 'Component01' and compared that selection alone with the whole LOD ('Component01 covers %d/%d vertices; uncovered vertices won't participate in collision.' and the same for faces): it fired whenever Component01 held fewer points or faces than the LOD, as on a healthy multi-component LOD, never read a LOD without an exact Component01 (lowercase components included), counted proxy triangles and points that no face uses, and did not run on View or Fire. Owner's choices the same day: coverage is the union of every selection named Component plus a number, in any case (#46's _COMPONENT_NAME_RE, fullmatch), on the Geometry, View and Fire LODs; points that no face uses are ignored; it stays a WARN. Implementation: it counts the faces that are not proxy triangles (#46's _proxy_triangle_faces) that no component holds, and the points those faces use that none holds; a nonzero weight is membership, as in the file; one finding per LOD; a LOD with no component is left to ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING, and one whose component selections are all empty is reported with every face counted; it ships under #46's unreleased 1.9.0 with no new wheel. In-game basis: the killer #2 run (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs collided with nothing; a face outside every component on a LOD that has others was not measured, so killer #8 now calls that consequence expected, not measured, and quotes the replaced text in dated notes. Offline: py3d suite 334 passed, 11 skipped (base: 309 passed, 11 skipped); the 25 new tests of test_s2_validate12.py run against the base commit's module fail 20 and pass 5 (guards: lowercase components covering the LOD, a LOD with no component, the face-outside mutant whose message test discriminates, and fractional weights, which instead fail on a mutant that counts only weight 1), and all 25 pass on the new one; dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH. Read-only impact run on 414 unique MLODs (the owner's mod and vehicle projects and the Pack's door samples) through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the base module and the new one: old 78 findings on 39 Geometry LODs, new 3 (the door sample Expert_Mode, whose lever is in no component in its Geometry and Fire LODs, and a vehicle Fire LOD with two 1 mm triangles in no selection); no other finding changed in any model. The impact and consumer runs used the module of 7cb410f; the review fixes after it change no executable line (AST compared without docstrings). Cross-family review: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of 2 rounds set before round 1: round 1 SOUND-WITH-FIXES (three P2, fixed), round 2 SOUND (all three resolved, no new finding). Skill notes on this finding (dayz-p3d-audit SKILL.md killer #8, references/killers-detail.md section 8) now say which py3d version does what; the py3d README test count follows the suite. Six wrong implementations each fail at least one of its tests: old det=+1 recipe 10, reflection alone 8, no normal negation 7, no un-reversal 5, collision LODs shifted 1 m (the cross-family review's mutant) 1, no shared-data check 2. Eight tests for ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS on the measured fixture: both disagreement states read alike and the message gives the order and its conditions; the signed volume picks the winding fix, each sign phrase (solid, room, collision) is tied to a measurement, and the other fix silences the finding while leaving the model inside-out; validate() is blind to variant C; a collision LOD's message asks for the per-component check; a shared pool entry is re-pointed, not negated in place; a shell agrees with itself before its volume counts; the odd face is turned without its normal; normals are fixed corner by corner. Offline, on the Rule 12 in-game fixture (variant B rebuilt byte for byte, SHA-256 asserted against MEASURED): B with its normals negated and B with its faces reversed both read 0 % and raise the same finding with identical text; per-box signed volume keeps B's negative sign (-0.084, -0.0132, -0.0066, -0.0048) with the normals turned and flips it with the faces turned; the wrong fix silences the finding and leaves cross product and normals outward on 48/48 faces; validate() returns [] on variant C. Cases from the two review rounds, each re-run by the receptor and now a test: a 6-entry shared pool negated in place leaves 75 % with the stem's 12 faces wrong; a plate with one reversed face keeps volume -0.084, so the volume alone leaves that face inside-out; turning a right odd face with its normal leaves 47/48 with validate() == []; negating whole faces on a first-corner reading leaves 48 of 144 corners right with 100 % agreement; the order above gives back B (48/48/48, 144 corners, pool kept at 6) in every case. A synthetic ring-shaped FireGeometry reads 264 of 336 correct faces outward by the centroid test. py3d suite 283 passed, 11 skipped (290 passed, 4 skipped with PY3D_UPSTREAM_PATH at upstream 7acd58b). Negative controls on the 8 new tests: da73457 fails 3, round-1 6a13435 fails 2, round-2 42a9d5b fails 1, and a mutated solid, room or collision sign fails 1 each. Five tests for ERR_WINDING_INVERTED on the clean multi-LOD fixture: where the finding lands with the visual or the geometry LOD inside-out, and the geometry LOD's text, the same in both numbers aside, naming the reference visual LOD and giving the steps for both LODs; each sign phrase of the message next to its measurement, and its steps run on the LODs it names reversing only the turned LOD and giving back the clean model; two visual LODs whose file order differs from the reference's; an inside-out open surface that stays unresolved; and the old message's fix, which trades the finding for ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS, then silences validate() with every LOD wound outward. shell_volume now goes through a signed_volume helper (same arithmetic). Offline, 2026-10-02, on the clean multi-LOD model of the py3d tests (build_multilod_v2_p3d after blender_to_dayz(), validate() == []): with the visual LOD's shell turned inside-out, faces and normals together (the absolute check passes it), ERR_WINDING_INVERTED fired on the three healthy collision LODs (geometry, view_geometry, fire_geometry: 0 % of faces wound outward from the LOD centroid, visual 100 %) and nowhere else, and no other finding saw the inside-out visual LOD; with the geometry LOD turned instead, on that LOD only (100 % vs 0 %). The visual shell's signed volume by winding reads negative on the clean model and positive turned (also what a room seen from inside is); the collision boxes read 0 of 6 faces outward clean and 6 of 6 turned. The message's winding steps, run on the visual LOD it names and on the collision LODs, reversed the turned LOD and nothing else (320 shell faces, or 6), and fixing the corners then gave back the clean model exactly (points, normal pools, vertex and normal indices, UVs). Reversing the faces of the three flagged LODs, the old message's fix, traded the finding for ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS on each; negating their normals as well left validate() at [] with every LOD wound outward, the collision boxes 6 of 6 outward as transform(ROT_X_NEG90) alone leaves them, the map whose collision LODs registered no raycast in game (py3d README, Blender -> DayZ). Headless smoke test for generated viewers: load, real canvas, geometry drawn, three revision reported by the imported module, no page/request/console errors. Chrome and puppeteer resolved from the environment, no machine paths. It does not assert parity; that is visual comparison.

Retract an overclaim in the header. It said parity IS established by visual comparison of screenshots; a calibration follow-up refuted that with a concrete attack - keep the render and the visible positions intact, swap two axes in the inverse conversion used when EXPORTING a memory point, and the screenshots stay identical while the exported value is wrong. Screenshots are a stronger and costlier projection, not a categorically different instrument. The header now names the blind spot (the exported number) and what vouches for it (a round-trip of the value, or real use downstream) instead of pointing at the pictures as the end of the argument.

Measured on 26e76a4 before wiring (Python 3.14.3, pytest 9.1.1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1): `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider skills/*/tests` (Git Bash; PowerShell does not expand the glob) exits 2 with 3 'import file mismatch' collection errors and no test run, because dayz-3d-viewer, dayz-animation-pipeline, dayz-p3d-inspector and dayz-proxy-align ship the same tests/test_install_py3d.py (sha256 da765cafdc63341c5fb17416e17f79422b5762ab9ae2f77befc388ef33066954) without __init__.py; each folder alone passes 6 (24 in all), and the four together pass 24 under --import-mode=importlib. The eight other tools/<tool>/tests folders pass alone (3d-viewer 15, animation-formats 97, layout-viewer 4, model-preflight 74, odol-strict 70 + 5 skipped for DAYZ_ODOL_BACKEND_ROOT not configured, script-validator 164, ui-lab 77, vehicle-proxy-contract 128 in 201-232 s) and abort together on the same basename collision. None of these twelve folders needs Blender, DayZ or the P: drive; skills/dayz-realistic-animation-director/scripts/tests/test_sample_blender_motion.py imports bpy and, like dayz-proxy-align/scripts/test_proxy_frame.py and dayz-mcp-verify/references/test_drive_ladder.py, sits outside skills/<skill>/tests and is not run. update/seanim-export-handedness@4ce4bbd's test_seanim_export.py (another session's branch, read only) passes 12 without Blender. Change: packctl/gate.py runs each skills/*/tests and tools/*/tests folder in its own pytest process (the gate excludes tools/py3d/tests, which its py3d_tests check runs) through _run_process (cwd = root, PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX in the report dir, PYTEST_ADDOPTS dropped from the environment of every gate pytest run, the directory holding packctl prepended to PYTHONPATH for the folder runs), as `pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -p packctl.pytest_observer --packctl-observer=<record> -rs <folder>`; checks skill_tests and tool_tests with per-folder verdict and returncode, findings SKILL-TESTS-FAILED and TOOL-TESTS-FAILED, a log and a run record per folder under <report-dir>/skill-tests and tool-tests. packctl/pytest_observer.py (new, imports pytest; the rest of packctl stays stdlib-only) records through pytest's hooks the items collected (pytest_itemcollected), the items left to run (pytest_collection_finish, tryfirst), the items that ran to the end (pytest_runtest_logfinish), the count deselected (pytest_deselected), failed collect and test reports, the modules that yielded items and those that skipped themselves at import (pytest_collectreport), and session.exitstatus (pytest_sessionfinish, trylast). Pass rule (_suite_passed): exit 0 or 5; a record written by this run (the previous one is unlinked first) whose exit status equals the process's; no failed report; nothing deselected; the items left to run equal the items collected, and all of them ran to the end; every test_*.py or *_test.py module of the folder (outside hidden and __pycache__ directories) yielded items or skipped itself at import; and an item to run, or, on exit 5, a module that skipped itself. `packctl test-folders --root <repo> --tree skills|tools --report-dir <dir>` runs the same checks alone (its tools tree includes tools/py3d/tests), with the gate's report-dir-outside-the-root refusal (GATE-REPORT-IN-ROOT, now shared through _report_dir_in_root), prints its report and writes test-folders.json; exit 1 on FAIL. Measured with pytest 9.1.1: a module-level pytest.importorskip exits 5 with one module skip, an empty folder and a script-style file exit 5 with nothing collected, a collection-only run exits 0 leaving its items unrun, and a conftest pytest.exit(returncode=0) after collection exits 0 leaving its items unrun. Real folders under the final rule on this tree (`packctl test-folders --tree skills --tree tools`): PASS, 4 skill folders and 9 tool folders (py3d: 294 items, 283 passed and 11 skipped at run time), every record with the items collected equal to the items run and every test module covered. CI's 'Test skills' step runs `python -m packctl test-folders --root . --tree skills --report-dir "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\skill-tests"`: under Windows PowerShell 5.1.22621 with GitHub's `shell: powershell` wrapper and a clean Python 3.12.14 venv holding only pytest 9.1.1 it exits 0 on the worktree (4 folders PASS) and 1 on a fixture with passing, failing, module-skip and script-style folders (beta exit 1 and script exit 5 FAIL, the module-skip folder PASS). Tool folders stay gate-only: in that venv five of them fail on ModuleNotFoundError (PIL, jsonschema x3, numpy and py3d). Fixtures first (tests/packctl/test_gate.py, test_cli.py): a failing skill test; a failing tool test with tools/py3d/tests left to the py3d check; same-basename folders plus a module-skip folder and a tool folder pass the whole gate; uncollectable, deselected and script-style folders fail; PYTEST_ADDOPTS=--collect-only does not reach the runs; addopts = --collect-only in the repository's pytest.ini fails; `addopts = -q -k test_passes --color=yes` fails; a failing module kept out of collection by python_files, --ignore or collect_ignore next to a module that skips itself fails; a conftest pytest.exit(returncode=0) after collection fails; 16 rows pin the rule on run records (exit codes 1-4, a record that disagrees with the process, failed, deselected, unfinished collection, dropped and added items, unrun items, an uncovered module, exit 5 without a skip, a non-integer count) plus missing, malformed and incomplete records and a record left by an earlier run; test-folders refuses a report dir inside the root, runs only the named tree, and runs tools/py3d/tests; the gate refuses a report dir inside the root before any folder runs. Red first: on the unchanged gate the round-1 tests failed 4 of 5; on 7141e8d the round-2 tests failed 25 of 25; on cfa26b7 (temporary detached worktree, removed) the round-3 behaviour tests failed 6 of 6 (quiet coloured deselection, the three collection narrowings and the ended run passed the gate; test-folders --tree tools left py3d out). Mutations through pytest plugins outside the repo, each caught by the tests: exit 5 always passing, exit 5 always failing, one process for all folders (round 1); the deselection summary ignored, PYTEST_ADDOPTS kept, exit 0 accepted without a test case, exit 5 accepted on any skip (round 2); completion of the collected items not checked, no module inventory, deselections not read (round 3). Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol (Codex desktop app CLI 0.159.2, read-only sandbox), cap of two rounds set before round 1. Round 1 on 7141e8d: UNSOUND; H01 P1 collection-only runs exit 0 with no test case and passed; H02 P1 a module-level skip plus deselected tests exits 5 with a skip and passed; H03 P2 the 'no test needs Blender' sentence covered the whole repository; H04 P2 no test pinned rejected exit codes or invalid reports; H05 P2 the PowerShell copy of the rule in CI diverged from the gate. All reproduced and fixed in cfa26b7 (JUnit counts, the deselection summary, PYTEST_ADDOPTS dropped, CI calling packctl test-folders). Round 2 on cfa26b7 (fresh session): UNSOUND; H01, H03, H05 CLOSED, H02 and H04 PARTIAL; H06 P1 the deselection summary disappears under `-q` in addopts or behind --color=yes; H07 P1 python_files, --ignore or collect_ignore keep a failing module out of collection next to a skipped one; H08 P1 a conftest pytest.exit(returncode=0) after collection passes; H09 P1 test-folders --tree tools excluded tools/py3d/tests without running it; H10 P2 negative counts cancelled across JUnit suites; H11 P2 CONTRIBUTING step 5's gate command lacked --report-dir. All reproduced and fixed after the cap, verified mechanically: the run record and module inventory replace the JUnit counts and the summary line (H06-H08, H10), test-folders keeps py3d in its tools tree (H09), the command gains --report-dir (H11), and a test pins that an earlier record is not read (H04). gate-1 on 7141e8d failed only BUILD-DIRTY: another agent session wrote an untracked file into the worktree root during the run (moved to the work dir); gate-2 on 7141e8d and gate-3 on cfa26b7: PASS, two identical builds, tree clean before and after; the folder checks took 490 s on a busy machine (gate-2) and 247 s (gate-3), almost all tools/dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract/tests.
